question: Two trains are moving in opposite directions at 60 km/h and 90 km/h. Their lengths are 1.2 km and 0.8 km respectively. In how much time will they cross each other?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = 60 + 90 = 150 km/h

Total distance to be covered = 1.2 + 0.8 = 2.0 km

Time = (Distance ÷ Relative Speed) × 3600

Time = (2 ÷ 150) × 3600 = 2 × 24 = 48 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 48 seconds.**
